title: Badava Rascal
desc: Kidnapped by thugs, a young man captivates his captors with the story of his life to compel them to second-guess their choices. The action-comedy movie stars Amrutha Iyengar, Rangayana Raghu, Nagabhushan and Tara.

title: Revolver Rani
desc: A politician in love with a rising Bollywood star must do whatever it takes to save him when he is kidnapped by her enemies. 'Revolver Rani' stars Kangana Ranaut, Vir Das, Piyush Mishra, Zakir Hussain and Zeishan Quadri.

title: Azhar
desc: Inspired by the life of Indian cricketer and former captain of the Indian national team, Mohammad Azharuddin. A talented young cricketer rises to prominence but finds his career threatened by accusations of match-fixing. 'Azhar' stars Emraan Hashmi, Lara Dutta and Nargis Fakhri.

title: Azhar
desc: Inspired by the life of Indian cricketer and former captain of the Indian national team, Mohammad Azharuddin. A talented young cricketer rises to prominence but finds his career threatened by accusations of match-fixing. 'Azhar' stars Emraan Hashmi, Lara Dutta and Nargis Fakhri.

title: Soorma
desc: Based on the life of hockey legend Sandeep Singh, 'Soorma' is a story of determination, hard work and love for the sport. When the upcoming hockey player is accidentally shot and left paralysed, he decides to do whatever it takes to overcome his disability so he can lead the Indian team to victory. The movie stars Diljit Dosanjh, Taapsee Pannu, Angad Bedi and Vijay Raaz.

title: Main Hoon Lucky The Racer
desc: Main Hoon Lucky The Racer is all about two brothers who do things differently. While one brother follows rules and regulations, the other tries to achieve it in his own unique way.

title: Poster Boyz
desc: Inspired by a true event, three men find themselves in a chaotic predicament when their photos grace a vasectomy advertisement. Subjected to ridicule by friends and family, they unite to rebel againstg the system. The comedy movie stars Shreyas Talpade, Sunny Deol and Bobby Deol.

title: Mujhse Shaadi Karogi
desc: In sunny Goa, a hot-headed Sameer falls for Rani, but his roommate Sunny also loves her and plots to sabotage his chances. Love and rivalry collide in this captivating coastal rom-com starring Salman Khan, Akshay Kumar and Priyanka Chopra.

title: Yeh Hai Adda
desc: A skilled relationship saboteur helps parents separate couples and operates from the marriage office. While helping a young woman split up her sister's relationship, he falls in love with her. 'Yeh Hai Adda' stars Sushanth and Shanvi in lead roles.

title: Policewala
desc: A young man, whose father fell victim to a gangster's violence, grows up to enlist in the police. During his pursuit of a notorious gang, he unintentionally uncovers the identity of his father's killer. 'Policewala' stars Chunky Pandey, Sonam, Vinod Mehra, Amjad Khan and Shakti Kapoor.

title: Sooryavansham
desc: Unable to live up to his father's expectations, Heera battles against adversity to uphold his family's honor and pride. 'Sooryavansham' stars Amitabh Bachchan in a double role, along with Soundarya, Jayasudha, Rachna Banerjee, Kader Khan, Anupam Kher, Mukesh Rishi and Aanand Vardhan.

title: Mubarakan
desc: Orphaned twins who are raised separately turn to their quirky unmarried uncle for romantic advice, unaware of the chaos and confusion in store for them. 'Mubarakan' stars Anil Kapoor, Arjun Kapoor, Ileana D'Cruz, Athiya Shetty, Neha Sharma, Ratna Pathak Shah, Karan Kundra, Rahul Dev, Pavan Malhotra and Sanjay Kapoor.
